concerns.text: T003 writes "real per-subject metric rows to data/results/metrics.csv with all fields required by output.schema.yaml", but that schema has no subject_id field, sets additionalProperties:false, and REQUIRES cohort-level fields (t_statistic, p_value_fdr, cohen_d, significant, benchmark_reference, practical_significance, validation_type) on every row. Per-subject rows written in Phase 1 (before T005 computes statistics) cannot satisfy the schema, making T003's deliverable and T006(a)'s validation unexecutable as specified. Either the schema needs a per-subject variant or T003 must emit only schema-valid fields.

T006(b) validates data/results/stats.json "against the same schema" (output.schema.yaml), but that schema describes a single metric row (type: object), not a statistics-results document; plan Task 5.2 references a contracts/stats.schema.yaml that does not exist. The implementer has no executable schema target for stats.json.

the noise floor (SD/SEM of the -200 to 0 ms pre-stimulus baseline)" is ambiguous — SD and SEM yield different SNR values, so the SNR >= 3.0 check is not deterministically executable. FR-011 says SD; output.schema.yaml says SEM. Pick one.

ICA artifact rejection says only "reject EOG/ECG-correlated components" with no detection method or threshold; spec US-1 acceptance scenario 2 specifies a criterion ("explaining >99% variance"). The implementer cannot deterministically decide which components to reject, and the acceptance scenario is unverifiable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Task format and paths vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Tasks write outputs to data/results/metrics.csv, data/results/stats.json, data/results/figures/ while plan.md's structure places them at results/. T006's contract tests and T008's re-run check will break if the implementer follows the plan layout; the tasks doc should state the authoritative path and note the plan divergence.

create this file citing the established medium-effect benchmark" does not name the citation source (which paper/reference defines d >= 0.5 as medium). The implementer cannot produce a verifiable benchmark file without a named primary source.

T004 bundles full-cohort rerun, template generation, and metrics.csv update in one task — coarse but acceptable granularity; however "one value per channel" check for canonical_mmn.npy is under-specified (which channel order / montage reference?) — the check cannot detect a wrong-channel-order template. Specify that channel order matches the epochs montage and is recorded alongside.
